abilities.effect: The blooms open, spawning a single wemmuth that acts on the hazard's initiative, and the hazard rolls for initiative.
abilities.name: Bloom
abilities.trigger: A non-plant creature enters the garden

hazard.description: Five large flowers in the weed-choked field unfurl, each dusting pollen onto vines that animate into wemmuths.
hazard.disable: DC 48 Nature (master) or DC 48 Performance (legendary) to calm a flower, closing it
hazard.name: Angry Vegetation
hazard.reset: Wemmuths collapse into ordinary vines and the trap resets if the area is left alone for 1 minute.
hazard.routine: (2 actions) If there are fewer wemmuths than open flowers, the flowers create more wemmuths (so there as many wemmuths as open flowers) as their first action. For their second action, the flowers produce a mind-addling pollen. Each non-plant creature within 30 feet of a flower must succeed at a DC 41 Fortitude save or become slowed 1 for 1 round (or confused for 1 round, on a critical failure). The pollen is an emotion, mental, and olfactory effect.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.note: to notice massive buds beneath the other foliage before they open

traits.name: Unique
traits.text: A rules element with this trait is one-of-a-kind. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to creatures with this trait is increased by 10.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
